_comment: Live, GitHub-Actions-verified remediation of a genuinely-Spring CVE: Spring Cloud Function SpEL RCE (CVE-2022-22963) in a real Spring Boot app. spring-cloud-function <= 3.2.2 evaluates the spring.cloud.function.routing-expression HTTP header as SpEL, so one unauthenticated POST to /functionRouter runs arbitrary code. Fix is a one-property pom.xml bump (spring-cloud-function.version 3.2.2 -> 3.2.3). No local JDK/Maven assumed: build, mvn test, and a real SpEL exploit probe run on GitHub Actions (see backend/app/remediation_targets/spring-cloud-fn-app/.github/workflows/ctem-verify.yml and scripts/spel_probe.py). Uses its own repo env var (CTEM_SPRING_REMEDIATION_REPO) so it never collides with the log4j maven target.

custom.name: Spring Cloud Function SpEL RCE — unauthenticated code execution via routing-expression header
